audience: Developers and researchers working with local open-weight language models who need to read representations, learn measured directions, and steer generation.
problem: Representation work often crosses opaque framework boundaries, making it difficult to bind a learned direction to the exact model, layer, width, method, and intervention point where it is valid.
promise: A native Rust path from contrastive examples and hidden states to measured steering artifacts and controlled generation.

secondaryAction.label: Inspect the source
secondaryAction.purpose: Review the native runtime, CLI, and versioned artifact contract.

approvedClaims.claim: Ster is a native Rust toolkit for representation reading and activation steering in open-weight language models.
Ster reads last-token hidden states from selected transformer layers, learns directions from contrastive examples, evaluates them, and applies them during generation.
Ster 0.12 provides one binary and one library crate using the same versioned JSON artifacts and native Candle runtime.

The current runtime supports local and Hugging Face Llama, Llama 4, Llama-Nemotron Super and Ultra, Mistral, Ministral 3, Mistral Large 3, Mixtral, Qwen2, Qwen2-MoE, Qwen3, Qwen3-MoE, Qwen3-Next, Qwen3.5, Qwen3.5-MoE, MiMo, MiMo-V2-Flash, MiMo-V2.5, Mellum, IQuest-Coder, IQuest-LoopCoder, HyperCLOVA X, Apertus, Solar Pro, Step1, openPangu-Embedded, openPangu-Ultra-MoE, Nanbeige, A.X-K1, K2-Horizon, LongCat-Flash, LongCat-Flash-Lite, Sarvam-30B, Sarvam-105B, Laguna, Muse Glimmer, PLaMo 3, HRM-Text, Inkling, Phi-2, Phi-3, PhiMoE, Granite, GraniteMoE, GraniteMoE Shared, Granite SWA, GraniteMoE SWA, Granite 4.0, StableLM, Starcoder2, Command R, Cohere2-MoE, Nemotron, Nemotron-H, Nemotron Puzzle, OLMo, OLMo 2, OLMo 3, OLMoE, FlexOlmo, OLMo Hybrid, EXAONE 3, EXAONE 4, K-EXAONE, InternLM2, InternLM3, Seed-OSS, Arcee, Arcee Trinity, Jais 2, Tele-FLM, ERNIE 4.5, ERNIE 4.5 MoE, MiniCPM, MiniCPM3, MiniMax-Text-01, MiniMax-M2, Orion, ChatGLM, GLM-4, GLM-4.5, GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-5, GLM-5-Next, GPT-NeoX, Pythia, GPT-J, GPT-2, StarCoder, OPT, BLOOM, Falcon, Falcon-H1, MPT, DBRX, DeepSeek-MoE, DeepSeek-V2, DeepSeek-V3, DeepSeek-V3.2, DeepSeek-V4, Kimi-Linear, Kimi-K3, Step3, Step 3.5, GPT-OSS, Ling, Ling 2.5 and 3.0, Param2-MoE, Mamba, Falcon-Mamba, Mamba-2, Jamba, Bamba, Zamba2, LFM2, LFM2-MoE, HunYuan, HunYuan-MoE, HY V3, TeleChat2, TeleChat3, SmolLM3, Gemma, Gemma 2, VaultGemma, Gemma 3, Gemma 3n, Rnj-1 and Gemma 4 Safetensors checkpoints on CPU, with compile-time Metal and CUDA backends.
Ster supports CAA, PCA, and logistic-probe training plus holdout selection across method and layer.
Ster evaluates artifacts with pair-ordering accuracy and projection margin before additive residual-stream steering during autoregressive generation.
Every steering artifact records product and schema identity, model revision, trait, method, hidden width, layer-indexed directions, training accuracy, and projection margin.
Ster refuses artifacts with the wrong product, schema, model, or vector width instead of applying them to the wrong residual stream.
Ster owns its Llama decoder loop so it can capture a residual state after a selected block and add a direction before the next block.
Ster controls local open-weight models; hosted model routing, fleet placement, credentials, and release delivery belong to other products.

requiredProof: The documented train and generate commands from the first steering workflow.
The six native CLI operations: train, optimize, evaluate, generate, extract, and inspect.
The versioned artifact fields and the product, schema, model, and vector-width refusal boundary.
The exact residual capture and addition points in the native Candle decoder loop.

rules: Use the canonical Wisent type, color, spacing, radius, and motion tokens.
Keep representation, artifact, and intervention language technically precise.
Use one primary action and concrete source-backed workflow evidence.
forbidden: Invented benchmark results, accuracy figures, performance claims, or supported model families.
Claims that Ster routes hosted models, manages fleets, or owns credentials.
Python package or wisent command compatibility claims.
Fake terminal output, fake artifacts, generic AI gradients, or glass cards.

notes: Preserve the current landing's approved read, learn, measure, and steer positioning only where the canonical README supports it.
Ster is the product; Wisent is the company.
